definition.ko: 관측된 클립 구간에서 앞무릎 투영 굴곡의 P10. 0°는 영상에서 펴진 관절입니다. 착지–릴리스 구간의 신전량과 다릅니다.
definition.en: P10 of projected flexion across the observed clip. 0° means projected straight. Distinct from event-aligned extension.

metrics.coordinateSystem: Halpe-26 crop pixels; image x right, y down
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Image projection depends on view and clip boundaries; not anatomical 3D flexion.

definition.ko: 골반 중점→어깨 중점 벡터와 영상 위쪽 수직선 사이 각도의 P90입니다. 해부학적 전경·측굴과 구분합니다.
definition.en: P90 angle between hip-midpoint→shoulder-midpoint and image up. Does not identify anatomical forward or lateral lean.

metrics.coordinateSystem: Halpe-26 crop pixels; image x right, y down
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.

definition.en: P90 projected angle of throwing upper arm relative to downward trunk. Arm along downward trunk is 0°.

metrics.coordinateSystem: Halpe-26 crop pixels; image x right, y down
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Image projection depends on view and clip boundaries; not anatomical 3D flexion.

definition.ko: 모델의 좌→우 어깨선과 좌→우 골반선을 추정 지면에 투영한 무부호 각도의 P50입니다. 해부학적 흉곽 회전이 아닙니다.
definition.en: P50 unsigned angle between left-to-right shoulder and hip lines projected onto inferred ground. Not anatomical thorax rotation.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Unvalidated monocular 3D geometry; excluded from default aggregate statistics. Not a laboratory measurement.

definition.ko: 관측 클립의 모델 수평 분리각 P90입니다. 최대 분리각이나 착지 시 값과 다릅니다.
definition.en: P90 horizontal separation across the observed clip. Not maximum separation or the landing value.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Unvalidated monocular 3D geometry; excluded from default aggregate statistics. Not a laboratory measurement.

definition.ko: 가장 긴 연속 유효 구간에서 수평 골반선 방향을 연속화한 후 P90−P10을 계산합니다. 투구 단계나 회전 속도를 뜻하지 않습니다.
definition.en: Unwrapped horizontal hip-line yaw P90−P10 in the longest contiguous supported run. Not a pitching-phase excursion or angular velocity.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Unvalidated monocular 3D geometry; excluded from default aggregate statistics. Not a laboratory measurement.

definition.ko: 모델 골반→목 벡터와 추정 장면의 수직선 사이 각도의 P90입니다. 투구 방향 기준 전경·측굴로 해석하지 않습니다.
definition.en: P90 angle of model pelvis→neck against estimated scene vertical. Not forward/lateral lean relative to pitching direction.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Unvalidated monocular 3D geometry; excluded from default aggregate statistics. Not a laboratory measurement.

definition.ko: 투구측 어깨→팔꿈치와 모델 목→골반 사이 각도의 P90입니다. 해부학적 어깨 외전이나 공의 진입각이 아닙니다.
definition.en: P90 model upper-arm angle against downward trunk. Not anatomical shoulder abduction or ball approach angle.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.
metrics.limitations: Unvalidated monocular 3D geometry; excluded from default aggregate statistics. Not a laboratory measurement.

definition.ko: 발목 사이 XZ 거리 / 양쪽 고관절–무릎–발목 길이 평균의 P90입니다. 착지 보폭이나 실측 거리가 아닙니다.
definition.en: P90 ankle XZ separation divided by mean hip–knee–ankle segment length. Not landing stride or measured distance.

metrics.coordinateSystem: SMPL-24 joint centers; clip-fixed inferred support; Y up; uncalibrated scale
metrics.conditions: At least 10 finite supported frames and >=50% of the clip; original 2D score >=0.5 at required observations; no interpolated/outlier joints. No gap filling or phase inference.

definition.ko: 착지 후보 범위 중앙에서의 투영 굴곡입니다.
definition.en: Projected flexion at landing-bracket midpoint.

metrics.coordinateSystem: Halpe-26 crop pixels; image x right, y down
metrics.conditions: Requires published provisional visual event brackets; original joint scores >=0.4 throughout; no filled observations; midpoint alignment; 3-frame box mean. Separate strict >=0.5 screen and sensitivity remain in source pilot.
metrics.limitations: Image projection depends on view and clip boundaries; not anatomical 3D flexion.

name.en: Additional projected knee bending after landing

name.en: Projected knee straightening after maximum bend

definition.en: Landing flexion minus release flexion. Negative means more bent at release than landing.

definition.en: First maximum bend in landing=0%, release=100% alignment. Not the time of peak extension speed.
